intent: Repair the existing CAP-0009 Fresh-Agent continuity drill harness after the seq103 external run showed controller/subject conflation: preserve the failing report, separate controller-only future cues and pass criteria from the subject-visible operating contract, and add a regression that prevents future-cue leakage without changing Longcycle product semantics or creating a new capability owner.
rationale_summary: The seq103 report at subject HEAD ba0f6d5b4975d86428462536acae1b9ef8af20c5 recovered DUMB-01/02/03 semantics correctly but violated staged execution because v1 exposed DUMB-02/DUMB-03 cue text and execution instructions in the same repository document the tested Agent was told to read. This is an observed continuity-test harness defect owned by CAP-0009, not evidence for a new semantic owner. V2 keeps the old FAIL immutable, moves future stimuli and expected-answer criteria to a controller-only contract, gives the tested Agent a separate subject contract with explicit stop/wait tokens, and tests that future cue text is absent from the subject contract.
